entities.summary: Piotr Arkadiusz Serafin is a Polish politician and lawyer who has served as European Commissioner for Budget, Anti-Fraud and Public Administration since December 2024. Between 2007–2008, he served as Undersecretary of State for European Integration and between 2012–2014 as Secretary of State of Foreign Affairs.
